LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicEye.label: solar eye
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicEye.description: An installed solar eye. With monocular/binocular capabilities and ultra-resolution picture, it is vastly superior than a mundane eye in every way. Dormant nanites allow it to recover from sustained damage.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicArm.label: solar arm
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicArm.description: An installed solar arm. Reinforced synthetic musculature greatly increases strength while connecting seamlessly to the body's nervous system. Dormant nanites allow it to recover from any sustained damage. It is vastly superior than a natural arm in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLeg.label: solar leg
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLeg.description: An installed solar leg. Reinforced musculature and Sunweave-based Shock absorbers allow for incredible mobility, equipped with an initially dormant Nanite Repair System it is vastly superior than a regular leg in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicSpine.label: solar spine
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicSpine.description: An installed solar spine. Bundles of Sunweave fiber run down an articulate core of Sunsteel, allowing for unmatched durability and control. It vastly outperforms a biological spine, say goodbye to back problems!
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicHeart.label: solar heart
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicHeart.description: An installed solar heart. Forgoing a natural heartbeat for constant bloodflow and further optimizing the oxygenation of blood, the implantee feels without fatigue in even the most demanding of situations. It is vastly superior to a biological heart in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicStomach.label: solar stomach
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicStomach.description: An installed solar stomach. Sunweave mesh alongside rigorous filtration systems render the implantee immunized to stomach diseases and food poisoning while dormant nanites standby to repair any damage possible sustained. It is vastly superior to a biological stomach in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicEar.label: solar ear
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicEar.description: An installed solar ear. An array of subdermal microphones capture sound and transmit it directly to the auditory nerve. It's sensitive enough to hear a cat before you see it, can't be damaged by loud noise, and is capable of filtering out background noise in high-volume environments.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicTongue.label: solar tongue
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicTongue.description: An installed solar tongue. Made of specially treated Sunweave-fibers and connected directly to the nervous system, it outperforms a natural tongue in terms of speaking, eating, and tasting.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicJaw.label: solar jaw
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicJaw.description: An installed solar jaw. Artisanally forged from Sunsteel, complete with tooth replacements and a backup speaker array connected to the vocal cords, equipped with microscopic servos allowing for a full range of motion.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLiver.label: solar liver
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLiver.description: An installed solar liver. Made from sunweave and equipped with several forms of toxin filter, plus emergency flush capability in case of total bodily saturation. It is vastly superior to a biological liver in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLung.label: solar lung
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicLung.description: An installed solar lung. Woven from Sunweave and wrapped around a sturdy frame of Sunsteel, it maintains incredible oxygen absorption while also remaining resilient against trauma. It is vastly superior to a biological lung in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicKidney.label: solar kidney
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicKidney.description: An installed solar kidney. Sunsteel components filter out almost every form of waste or recycle it back into the body for re-use. It is vastly superior to a biological kidney in every way.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarDuelflowLattice.label: solar duelflow lattice
LanguageData.BOR_SolarDuelflowLattice.description: A combat telemetry implant that predicts strike cadence milliseconds ahead, pushing close-quarters lethality into the red.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGraviticStrikeGovernor.label: solar gravitic strike governor
LanguageData.BOR_SolarGraviticStrikeGovernor.descript: A forearm governor that phase-loads impact vectors so every blow lands heavier than flesh should allow.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarReflexOverclockSpindle.label: solar reflex overclock spindle
LanguageData.BOR_SolarReflexOverclockSpindle.descript: A spinal overclock spindle that clears neuromotor lag between consecutive swings.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarMonomassEdgeHarmonizer.label: solar monomass edge harmonizer
LanguageData.BOR_SolarMonomassEdgeHarmonizer.descript: A targeting harmonizer that aligns edge geometry against armor grain for cleaner penetrations.

LanguageData.BOR_SolarSubstrateFilterLung.label: solar substrate filter lung
LanguageData.BOR_SolarSubstrateFilterLung.description: An advanced artificial lung fitted with microfilters and stabilizers. It keeps airflow steady while supporting the fine breathing control needed for neutronium substrate work.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarPhaseTunedOcularImplant.label: solar phase-tuned ocular implant
LanguageData.BOR_SolarPhaseTunedOcularImplant.descrip: An installed ocular replacement with wide-spectrum sensors for reading transmutation bands and phase drift. It is tuned for precision rather than battlefield utility.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicPrecisionHand.label: solar bionic precision hand
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBionicPrecisionHand.description: An artificial hand replacement built for careful assembly work. Its calibrated actuators make it especially useful for intricate fabrication.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBreathPacerImplant.label: solar breath-pacer implant
LanguageData.BOR_SolarBreathPacerImplant.description: An implanted breathing pacer that keeps the chest rhythm steady and responsive under substrate stress.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarQuantumCoherenceNeurocalculator: An installed neurocalculator that offloads coherence-state calculations from conscious thought.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarResonanceEarImplant.label: solar resonance ear implant
LanguageData.BOR_SolarResonanceEarImplant.description: An auditory implant that converts field fluctuations into harmonic feedback for instant micro-corrections.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarMicroTremorStabilizer.label: solar micro-tremor stabilizer
LanguageData.BOR_SolarMicroTremorStabilizer.descripti: An implanted servo network that cancels involuntary muscle tremors before they can affect fine assembly work.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarSurgicalCognitionAssistant.desc: An implanted cognitive overlay that keeps procedural assembly schematics in active working memory.

LanguageData.BOR_SolarSurgicalCortexWeave.description: A cortical implant that overlays surgical procedure flow in real time to reduce operative mistakes.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarNanoSutureFingers.label: solar nano-suture fingers
LanguageData.BOR_SolarNanoSutureFingers.description: An implant package of micro-actuators in the hand that improves tend quality and treatment speed.

LanguageData.BOR_SolarInterrogatorLarynx.label: solar interrogator larynx
LanguageData.BOR_SolarInterrogatorLarynx.description: A vocal and resonance implant that improves command presence and coercive interviews.
LanguageData.BOR_SolarCipherCortexNode.label: solar cipher cortex node
LanguageData.BOR_SolarCipherCortexNode.description: A neural decryption co-processor that supports stealthier and faster hostile system access.

LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicEye.label: kwazaari eye
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicEye.description: An installed kwazaari eye. Capable of seeing a mouse's heat signature hidden in the grass at a Kilometer's distance, to compare it to an organic eye is almost insulting. Proprietary MicroMachines allow it to recover from any damage sustained.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicArm.label: kwazaari arm
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicArm.description: An installed kwazaari arm. Synthetic Quasar Alloy synthetic muscle fibers and endoskeletal hydraulics allow for unparalleled strength, while additionally being capable of regenerating should it somehow be damaged. Comparing this to an organic arm is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLeg.label: kwazaari leg
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLeg.description: An installed kwazaari leg. Quasar Alloy wiring connects seamlessly with the human nervous system and bleeding-edge shock absorption allows for breakneck movement speed, comparing it to an organic leg is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicSpine.label: kwazaari spine
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicSpine.description: An installed kwazaari spine. Innovative and minorly (read: incredibly) invasive installation procedures allow for peerless spinal comfort and flexibility. Comparing it to an organic spine is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicHeart.label: kwazaari heart
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicHeart.description: An installed kwazaari heart. A solid core of Quasar Alloy with high-powered pumps to allow for near-superhuman bloodflow. To compare it to an organic heart is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicStomach.label: kwazaari stomach
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicStomach.description: An installed kwazaari stomach. Bleeding-Edge filtration and detection technology renders the implantee not only immune to food poisoning and stomach parasites, but also immune to bloating and cramps for maximum comfort. Comparing it to an organic stomach is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicEar.label: kwazaari ear
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicEar.description: An installed kwazaari ear. Seamless listening arrays lining the external structure of the ear allow for matchless audio quality and volume attenuation, you can hear a pin drop in a live firefight while an ear of this level is installed.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicTongue.label: kwazaari tongue
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicTongue.description: An installed kwazaari tongue. Made from private patents sourced from the most prestigious of Kwazaari Research and Development Sectors, the Quasar Tongue opens up the culinary world to incorporate 3 additional flavors alongside the pre-established which are magnified to almost divine heights.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicJaw.label: kwazaari jaw
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicJaw.description: An installed kwazaari jaw. Beautifully carved from Quasar Alloy, often the skin is not grafted back overtop these jaws in order to preserve their vexing beauty, to say nothing of their immeasurable performance and configurability.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLiver.label: kwazaari liver
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLiver.description: An installed kwazaari liver. To call it a 'liver' is somewhat of a misnomer, as it is more of a compact industrial waste filter within the body. Even so, comparing it to an organic liver is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLung.label: kwazaari lung
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicLung.description: An installed kwazaari lung. Specialized fibrous mesh is woven loosely around Quasar Alloy girding within the organ, allowing for near-lossless oxygen intake for the average human body. Comparing it to an organic lung is almost insulting.
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicKidney.label: kwazaari kidney
LanguageData.BOR_QuasarBionicKidney.description: An installed kwazaari kidney. Polymeric nanoadsorbents and zeolites are present within the organ in order to maximize the re-usable material while it is filtered through. Comparing it to an organic kidney is almost insulting.

LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicEye.label: tenebral eye
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicEye.description: An installed Tenebral eye. Equipped with single-photon avalanche diode detector suites for use with the internal rangefinder alongside thermal, ultraviolet, and Infared night vision complete with IR strobe. There is nothing you cannot see with an Eye of this caliber.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicArm.label: tenebral arm
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicArm.description: An installed Tenebral arm. Mechanoneural interfaces designed with Tenebrite components make this limb feel entirely natural while still having enough power and precision to rip out a man's heart while preserving the rest of the torso cavity. Whatever you may wish to do with an arm, this one exceeds those meager whims by leaps and bounds.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLeg.label: tenebral leg
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLeg.description: An installed Tenebral leg. So far above an organic leg in terms of performance, durability, and comfort that most who are implanted with only a single leg for replacement prosthesis often return within a week missing their other leg.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicSpine.label: tenebral spine
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicSpine.description: An installed Tenebral spine. Making use of bioactive signallers alongside a Tenebrite-reinforced frame to grant the human form enough power to lift a car above their head with minimal issue, provided Tenebral arms and legs are additionally installed. Strength known only to human mythos now in the palm of your hand, or more accurately the square of your back.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicHeart.label: tenebral heart
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicHeart.description: An installed Tenebral heart. Dark black bundles of synthetic cardiac fibers beat with an unsettling rhythm within the chest of those this organ has been installed, their bodies now capable of running for three days without breaking so much as a sweat. Herculean endurance runs in through the veins of those with a heart of this level installed.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicStomach.label: tenebral stomach
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicStomach.description: An installed Tenebral stomach. So robust in its digestive ability the nutritional value of ingested food is nearly lossless, those with this organ installed are known to subsist off grains of rice. Famine is a thing of the past, the future ever onwards provides immeasurable plenty.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicEar.label: tenebral ear
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicEar.description: An installed Tenebral ear. Jet black synthskin grafted upon the side of the head crammed full of technology to such a degree you can almost hear people's thoughts based off the stimulation of their vocal chords. The beating of a man's heart, the shift of tectonic plates, a radio signal coming from deep space, all can be heard by you now.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicTongue.label: tenebral tongue
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicTongue.description: An installed Tenebral tongue. Hyperflexible strands of Tenebrous fiber connected to such a rich array of sensors and scanners that even the most novice of gourmands can dissect their meals down to the chemical makeup of its preparation, even the air has a taste now.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicJaw.label: tenebral jaw
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicJaw.description: An installed Tenebral jaw. Obsidian crystalline teeth capable of biting through power armor with enough precision to write solely using the range of motion provided.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicKidney.label: tenebral kidney
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicKidney.description: An installed Tenebral kidney. Providing lossless hydroequilibrium within the body, Tenebral kidneys only require a few drops of water to sustain the human body for prolonged periods.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLiver.label: tenebral liver
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLiver.description: An installed Tenebral liver. A coal-colored mesh of Tenebral strands capable of attacking and destroying any and all toxins within the body while not impeding bloodflow in the slightest. Pestilence is a thing of the past now that we have these.
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLung.label: tenebral lung
LanguageData.BOR_TenebralBionicLung.description: An installed Tenebral lung. Providing lossless oxygen saturation to the bloodstream, the human body barely even needs draw breath with Tenebral lungs installed, such is the power of Tenebral technology.

LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicEye.label: umbral eye
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicEye.description: An installed Umbral eye. A black marble capable of "seeing through" solid matter by piercing the material at the molecular level and then reconstructing what it finds on the other side using on-board AR (Augmented Reality) software, capable of seeing both UltraViolet (UV) and InfraRed (IR), coupled with night vision support. The quad-lense telescopic monocular encompassing the visuals portion of the eye is capable of seeing starships in the upper atmosphere with enough detail to make out scrapes in the paint job.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicArm.label: umbral arm
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicArm.description: An installed Umbral arm. With enough power to cause seismic events simply by striking the ground while also harboring the precision with which to assemble a mosaic on the molecular level.\n\n The ability to cook a live chicken by slapping it with every ounce of your strength was discovered by accident one day involving a swift argument between an Umbral soldier and a most ornery fowl.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLeg.label: umbral leg
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLeg.description: An installed Umbral leg. Swift enough to outrun bullets, provided you know how to do so. For those without the proper training it is still so far above an upgrade to mortal flesh there is no reason to abstain from making use of its fearsome power.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicSpine.label: umbral spine
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicSpine.description: An installed Umbral spine. This jet-black seam running through the torso imbues the human form with impossible flexibility, warriors are incapable of being surprised as they twist 180 degrees to lay waste upon the poor fools who thought they had an upper hand.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicHeart.label: umbral heart
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicHeart.description: An installed Umbral heart. It beats uncomfortably well within the torso cavity without so much as beating at all, continous bloodflow throughout the body ensures the pinnacle of efficiency while being capable of lowering pressure should bloodloss begin.\n\n "The Black heart does not beat alone." -Attributed, Umbral Dominion Medical Board
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicStomach.label: umbral stomach
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicStomach.description: An installed Umbral stomach. A maximum efficiency Bio-Reactor giving every ounce of nutrition from organic matter consumed, in extreme cases those who harbor Umbral stomachs have been known to eat rocks to ward off starvation beset by a year of food deprivation.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicEar.label: umbral ear
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicEar.description: An installed Umbral ear. Powerful enough to hear the ceaseless fusion of a star from planetside, the Umbral ear proves no sound in the galaxy is beyond its near-impossible perfection.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicTongue.label: umbral tongue
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicTongue.description: An installed Umbral tongue. Capable of 12 motions beyond reasonable scope, the implant is also capable of splitting and recombining as seen fit to better suit the whims of its user.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicJaw.label: umbral jaw
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicJaw.description: An installed Umbral jaw. Strong enough to chew through Powered armor while also being so heinously sharp it is capable of splitting an atom should the safeties be disabled. Its vocal modulator is designed to perfectly emulate any and all voices or sounds the user has ever heard or can imagine.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLung.label: umbral lung
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLung.description: An installed Umbral lung. Tuned intake and outtake valves ensure a lossless, constant flow of oxygen and carbon dioxide, supplying the body with a perfect amount of air while leaving them incapable of being breathless.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLiver.label: umbral liver
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicLiver.description: An installed Umbral liver. Capable of filtering venom which would normally slay 100 men within less than a minute. Immuno-boosting fibers present in the organ boost the body's ability to ward off disease to such a nightmarish degree that illness is no longer measured in days but seconds.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicKidney.label: umbral kidney
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralBionicKidney.description: An installed Umbral kidney. This deceptive organ is capable of filtering the equivalent of a plantary ocean within three hours, lowered further if two are installed in the body.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralDuelflowLattice.label: umbral duelflow lattice
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralDuelflowLattice.description: A combat telemetry implant that predicts strike cadence milliseconds ahead, pushing close-quarters lethality into the red.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralGraviticStrikeGovernor.label: umbral gravitic strike governor
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralGraviticStrikeGovernor.descrip: A forearm governor that phase-loads impact vectors so every blow lands heavier than flesh should allow.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralReflexOverclockSpindle.label: umbral reflex overclock spindle
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralReflexOverclockSpindle.descrip: A spinal overclock spindle that clears neuromotor lag between consecutive swings.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralMonomassEdgeHarmonizer.label: umbral monomass edge harmonizer
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralMonomassEdgeHarmonizer.descrip: A targeting harmonizer that aligns edge geometry against armor grain for cleaner penetrations.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralPredictiveDuelReticle.label: umbral predictive duel reticle

LanguageData.BOR_UmbralInertialSidestepGyros.descript: Subdermal gyros that fire counter-impulses to slip incoming blows by centimeters.

LanguageData.BOR_AegisHigh.label: aegis
LanguageData.BOR_AegisHigh.description: Aegis-induced immunity to illness. Only capable of blocking new ailments; it does nothing for those already sick, even if their illness is dormant.
LanguageData.BOR_SunliteHigh.label: sunlite blessed
LanguageData.BOR_SunliteHigh.description: Active sunlite in the bloodstream. Generates an euphoric high.
LanguageData.BOR_Chemical_SunweaveTolerance.label: sunweave-based chemicals tolerance
LanguageData.BOR_Chemical_SunweaveTolerance.descripti: A built-up tolerance to Sunweavium . The more severe this tolerance is, the more Sunweavium -based drugs like yayo or flake it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunweave_Chemical_Addiction.label: sunweave-based chemicals addiction
LanguageData.BOR_Sunweave_Chemical_Addiction.descript: A chemical addiction to Sunweavium . Long-term presence of Sunweave-based Chemicals has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of Sunweave-based Chemicals from drugs like flake or yayo, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.BOR_TrotHigh.label: high on trot
LanguageData.BOR_TrotHigh.description: Trot in the bloodstream. It supercharges combat-related abilities, and instantly increases psyfocus when first injected.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel_Chemical_Addiction.label: sunsteel chemical addiction
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel_Chemical_Addiction.descript: A chemical addiction to sunsteel-derived drugs. Long-term presence of trot has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of trot, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel_Chemical_Tolerance.label: sunsteel chemical tolerance
LanguageData.BOR_Sunsteel_Chemical_Tolerance.descript: A built-up tolerance to sunsteel-derived chemicals. The more severe this tolerance is, the more it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.BOR_WideAWakeHigh.label: high on wide-a-wake
LanguageData.BOR_WideAWakeHigh.description: Wide-a-wake in the bloodstream. It fills the need for rest by stimulating the brain, and increases focus, allowing faster work. It also increases the psyfocus gains from meditation.
LanguageData.BOR_CanterHigh.label: high on canter
LanguageData.BOR_CanterHigh.description: Canter in the bloodstream. It supercharges combat-related abilities, and instantly increases psyfocus when first injected.
LanguageData.BOR_CastraHigh.label: castra
LanguageData.BOR_CastraHigh.description: Castra-induced immunity to illness. This only blocks new infections; it does nothing for those who are already infected, even if their infection is dormant.
